Love, Learn and Grow together
At St Mary’s Wavendon C of E Primary School, we are a caring and ambitious community where children Love, Learn and Grow together.
Term Dates
Vision & Values
Careers
Our Trust
A very warm welcome to St Mary's Wavendon Church of England School.
Our school is a vibrant and nurturing community where every child is valued, supported, and inspired to flourish.
Rooted in Christian values, our ethos is built upon love, respect, and compassion. These principles guide our daily interactions and underpin our commitment to providing a holistic education that nurtures both academic excellence and personal growth.
We believe that education is a partnership between home and school. We warmly invite you to be an active part of our community, working together to support your child’s learning journey. Through open communication and close collaboration, we create an environment where every child can thrive—academically, socially, and spiritually.

pageCache.pageTitle: Absence - St Mary’s Wavendon C of E Primary – Milton Keynes
pageCache.text:
Absence
On the first day of absence parents should call the school office on 01908 582182 or email absence@stmaryswavendoncofe.co.uk to tell us that their child will be absent and why.
This should be done before morning registration.
Parents should give an indication, if possible, of how long their child is expected to be absent from school. The school office staff will ensure this information is passed to the class teacher.
It is unlikely for absences to frequently be for the whole family, and patterns such as these will be monitored and the LA informed of such patterns.
Parents should contact the school daily during the child’s absence. If parents fail to contact the school, a member of school staff will contact the parents by telephone to query the absence.
For further information please refer to our Attendance Policy.

pageCache.pageTitle: Headteacher’s Welcome - St Mary’s Wavendon C of E Primary – Milton Keynes
pageCache.text:
Headteacher’s Welcome
Dear Parents, Carers, and Visitors,
A very warm welcome to St Mary's Wavendon Church of England School.
Our school is a vibrant and nurturing community where every child is valued, supported, and inspired to flourish.
Rooted in Christian values, our ethos is built upon love, respect, and compassion. These principles guide our daily interactions and underpin our commitment to providing a holistic education that nurtures both academic excellence and personal growth.
At the heart of our school is our shared vision:
“This is our school. With God’s help we care for one another, are curious in our learning, and know we are all loved.”
This is beautifully reflected in our core values of Love, Thankfulness, Peace, Perseverance and Hope, Friendship, Forgiveness, and Trust—values that are not only taught, but lived throughout our school community.
Our guiding scripture, taken from Luke 10:27, reminds us daily: “Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’; and, ‘Love your neighbour as yourself.” These words are central to who we are, shaping our culture and inspiring our motto: Love, Learn, Grow.
As part of the Inspiring Futures through Learning (IFtL) family, we are proud to collaborate with a network of schools dedicated to educational excellence. In particular, we have a strong and growing relationship with Glebe Farm School, our feeder school and fellow IFtL partner. This close connection allows us to provide a smooth and supportive transition for our pupils and enriches our shared approach to learning, values, and community.
We believe that education is a partnership between home and school. We warmly invite you to be an active part of our community, working together to support your child’s learning journey. Through open communication and close collaboration, we create an environment where every child can thrive—academically, socially, and spiritually.
We hope our website gives you a flavour of life at St Mary’s.
We look forward to welcoming you to our St Mary’s family.
Warm regards Hayley Cook - Headteacher

pageCache.pageTitle: Young Carers - St Mary’s Wavendon C of E Primary – Milton Keynes
pageCache.text:
Young Carers
At our school, we recognise the incredible dedication and resilience of young carers—children and young people who take on responsibilities at home to support a family member who may have an illness, disability, mental health condition, or addiction.
Being a young carer can mean helping with everyday tasks such as cooking, cleaning, or looking after siblings, as well as providing emotional support and companionship. While caring for a loved one can be rewarding, it can also bring challenges, including balancing schoolwork, friendships, and personal wellbeing.
We are committed to creating a supportive and understanding environment for our young carers. Our team is here to listen, provide guidance, and ensure that every child has the opportunity to thrive both academically and personally. If you or someone you know is a young carer, please reach out—we are here to help.
For more information and support, please speak to a member of staff or visit [https://carersmiltonkeynes.org/information-for-carers/young-carers/]

Governors
Governors are a vibrant group of committed volunteers that represent and reflect the community of the school (parents, school colleagues and our wider community). Our governors are a key part of the strategic leadership of the school.
The Local Governing Body help set and dedicate themselves to the vision, values and strategic direction of the schools, maintaining their individuality whilst encouraging collaboration and sharing of excellence. They share responsibilities for supporting, monitoring and evaluating the performance of the schools in delivering a fulfilling, broad and balanced education for all their children.
The Local Governing Body:
Carries out its delegated functions and responsibilities which are focused upon:
David Hopkins (Chair)
Louise Armstrong-Swain
If you are interested in becoming a governor or would like to make contact with the Chair, please contact the Chair or Stephanie Boak, IFtL Head of Governance, on sboak@iftl.co.uk
Alternatively, please send a letter in a sealed envelope marked 'Chair of the Local Governing Body' via the school office.

Inspiring futures through learning
Glebe Farm School is proud to be part of the Inspiring Futures through Learning (IFtL) family of schools.
Our IFtL Family
At Inspiring Futures through Learning (IFtL) Multi-Academy Trust, we are committed to developing a family of schools who inspire all of our futures through learning. Schools within our Trust share the same values and ethos; our teams are constantly in the pursuit of development and excellence everyday. We open doors to opportunity and unlock the potential of both our children and our adults so that we all develop the confidence to achieve both our independent and collective ambitions. At IFtL, we are never alone. We know we are stronger together – one united family striving for excellence for all, in everything we do.
Trust Vision
To inspire the futures of us all through learning together

pageCache.pageTitle: SEND - St Mary’s Wavendon C of E Primary – Milton Keynes
pageCache.text:
SEND
Our Special Educational Needs and Disability (SEND) vision statement
At St Mary’s Wavendon, we are passionate about all children achieving the very best possible educational and personal outcomes. We believe in high ambitions for all our children including those with special educational needs. It is fundamental that we provide an adaptive approach based on what every child needs to ensure that all their individual needs are fully met and every child achieves their full potential.
We always endeavour to provide a safe, positive and nurturing environment whereby our children feel able to build upon their strengths and have the confidence to overcome their areas of development. It is essential that all children have access to the rich, broad and balanced curriculum that we offer all our children at Woodnewton and that we adapt based on their individual needs to ensure this occurs. In exceptional circumstances we understand the need to provide a highly personalised and bespoke curriculum offer and actively collaborate and work in partnership with external professionals to make sure this is of the highest quality directly tailored to meet their needs. High ambitions and reaching potential is an expectation for every child.
We believe in high aspirations and expectations of all pupils including those with SEND. We remain focused on the outcomes for all children with a view that they are unique and nurturing individual talents and outcomes. A key part of our role is to foster independence, self-esteem and confidence. We achieve this by setting appropriate learning outcomes and using a wide range of strategies, which are personalised to the individual. We know our children well and this is central to our provision and support put in place.
All children at St Mary's Wavendon C of E are on the same educational journey and are aiming for the same goals but we know all children will be at different points along their journey; however the end points remain the same. It is our duty to adapt and support appropriately for these to be achieved.
At St Mary’s Wavendon C of E, we value and believe in the importance of close working with our parents/ carers and families. Communication, honesty and transparent relationships are key. We actively resolve barriers together to ensure in partnership, we achieve the very best we can for every child. External professional support and guidance are an additional important resource to ensure the best provision for our SEND children. To this end, we actively encourage and respond to the guidance they give us.
St Mary's Wavendon C of E is a fully inclusive and caring school with the children at the heart of everything we do. Our offer provides a wide range of strategies and additional provision including full accessibility across the whole school for all, where appropriate, to support children with the various areas of SEND: including cognition and learning, social and emotional needs, communication and interaction needs, learning difficulties and physical needs. We are committed to swiftly identify every child’s specific and bespoke needs and respond appropriately to enable them to make strong progress in all areas of their school life alongside their peers.
Our SEND Principles

pageCache.pageTitle: Extra Curricular Activities - St Mary’s Wavendon C of E Primary – Milton Keynes
pageCache.text:
Extra Curricular Activities
St Mary’s Primary School offers a wide and varied extra-curricular programme for all pupils who wish to take part. Clubs run after school from 3:10 pm to 4:10 pm.
Our club offerings change each term and a full timetable is shared with parents at the start of every term. This includes details of all available clubs and instructions on how to sign up using our online booking system.
There is no charge for any of our extra-curricular clubs.
Bookings for clubs will open on MCAS at 6:00pm on Wednesday 9th September and will close at 9.00am on Friday 11th September.
